channel.title: Events on Da Nang Language Exchange
channel.description: Recent content in Events on Da Nang Language Exchange

item.title: Friday April 24 Numbered Table Rotations
item.description: Our Friday, April 24, 2026 session was smaller because of the holiday period in Vietnam, but the new numbered-table rotation system worked extremely well and gave everyone a balanced amount of speaking time.

item.title: Friday Cafe Language Exchange
item.description: A structured Friday night session with English and Vietnamese practice, numbered table rotations, timed changes, and topic prompts to keep conversations balanced and useful.

item.title: Friday April 17 Balanced Rotations Night
item.description: Our Friday, April 17, 2026 session had a strong, comfortable atmosphere, well-matched Vietnamese and international attendance, 30-minute rotations that worked well, and enough engagement that some members stayed talking until closing time at 10:10 PM.

item.title: Friday April 10 Structured Practice Night
item.description: Our Friday, April 10, 2026 session brought together around 20 Vietnamese and international members for a relaxed but focused evening of structured conversation practice that ran later than planned because engagement stayed strong.

item.title: Friday April 3 At An Hoi Cafe
item.description: Our Friday, April 3, 2026 session at An Hoi Cafe was a smaller, relaxed evening with strong short-notice turnout, many new faces, and an outdoor setting that people really enjoyed.

item.title: Friday March 27 Session Recap
item.description: Our Friday, March 27, 2026 session at Cotto Cafe near the FPT area went really well, with strong turnout, great feedback from members, and a cafe partnership offer that could make future sessions there even better.
